# Vien.noir

> Vien.noir is a Vienna-based live-entertainment world combining live music, aerial acrobatics, dance, burlesque and theatrical storytelling. The website is bilingual; German is the primary language and English versions are available under /en/.

Vien.noir presents its own stage and dinner-show productions in Vienna and offers artists and bespoke show concepts for private and corporate events. The 2026/27 season features Ladies of Bond, Season of Desire and Santa Baby. For current performance dates, availability and ticket information, use the programme and individual show pages rather than relying on summaries.

Official website: https://www.viennoir.com/
Primary language: German (de-AT)
Secondary language: English
Location: Vienna, Austria
Site operator/brand context: Vien.noir · Verein Opera Moderne Wien

## Main pages

- [Vien.noir home](https://www.viennoir.com/): Overview of Vien.noir, the 2026/27 season, its artistic concept and current highlights.
- [Programme 2026/27](https://www.viennoir.com/programm/): Current Vien.noir performance dates and the season programme in Vienna.
- [About Vien.noir](https://www.viennoir.com/ueber-uns/): Background, history, values and the people behind Vien.noir.
- [Event services](https://www.viennoir.com/event-services/): Artists and bespoke entertainment concepts for corporate events, galas, weddings and special occasions.
- [Contact](https://www.viennoir.com/kontakt/): General enquiries, collaborations, ticket questions and event-booking enquiries.

## Shows

- [Ladies of Bond](https://www.viennoir.com/ladies-of-bond-vienna/): A cinematic cabaret thriller inspired by the world of James Bond, featuring live vocals, dance, burlesque and aerial acrobatics.
- [Season of Desire](https://www.viennoir.com/season-of-desire-vienna/): An opulent Vienna-set stage show blending pop and classical music, live vocals, aerial acrobatics, intrigue and a Bridgerton-inspired atmosphere; includes a show FAQ.
- [Santa Baby](https://www.viennoir.com/santa-baby-dinner-show/): A festive Christmas dinner show with live music, dance, comedy and theatrical storytelling around the search for Mrs Claus.
